system.monsterType: Undead, Enchanted (Rare). Mummies are undead monsters; the carefullyprepared and bandage-swathed remains of longdead nobles and guardians—who lurk near deserted ruins and tombs. Mummies are often created as guardians for these tombs; they, are charged with the task of killing anyone who breaks into the tomb, even if they must follow the trespassers to the very ends of the earth.
